name: elmcn
description: shadcn/ui components for Elm, distributed as a shadcn registry

scripts.build: bun run docs:gen && bun run types && vite build --base /elmcn/ && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
scripts.check: bun run docs:gen && bun run types && tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.docs.json && elm-format src docs --validate && elm-review && shadcn registry validate && bun scripts/check-registry.ts
